prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Cobalt and Chalk: page #FFFFFF, text #132349, accent #164AC6, secondary surface #E8EFFC, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
